sentences.text: BAIL APPLICATION NO.44 OF 2021  SHAIKH AMER SHAIKH BABA  VERSUS  THE STATE OF MAHARASHTRA

...
 Advocate for Applicant : Mr. Md Imran Khan M Ismail Khan  APP for Respondent/State : Mr. P.G. Borade  ...
 CORAM : MANGESH S. PATIL, J.
 DATE : 08.02.2021 PER COURT :

entities.text: Md Imran Khan M Ismail Khan
entities.label: LAWYER

sentences.text: At the joint request of the parties, the matter is adjourned to 18.02.2021.

Till then in the event of arrest of the applicant in connection with Crime No.414/2020 registered with the M.I.D.C., CIDCO,
Police Station, Aurangabad for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of the Indian Penal Code read with Section 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, he shall be released on bail on his executing personal recognizance for an amount of Rs.20,000/- and furnishing a solvent surety in the like amount subject to following conditions:
a) He shall attend the concerned Police Station as and when called by the Investigating Officer and shall co-operate him.
b) He shall not tamper the evidence or influence the witnesses.
